commands.command:
set -euo pipefail; ROOT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/tracker/checkpoints/phase3-field-reacceptance-20260911"; STAMP=$(cat "$ROOT/LATEST"); OUT="$ROOT/$STAMP"; python3 - "$OUT" <<'PY'
import os,re,sys
out=sys.argv[1]
files=['logcat-before.txt','logcat-after-export.txt','logcat-final.txt']
rx=re.compile(r'(Killing|has died|am_kill|Force stopping|lowmemory|lmkd)',re.I)
app=re.compile(r'io\.blueeye',re.I)
rows=[]
for fn in files:
 p=os.path.join(out,fn)
 if not os.path.exists(p): continue
 for line in open(p,errors='replace'):
  if app.search(line) and rx.search(line):
   s=re.sub(r'pid=\d+','pid=<PID>',line.strip())
   s=re.sub(r'ProcessRecord\{[^}]+\}','ProcessRecord{...}',s)
   rows.append((fn,s))
print('matched='+str(len(rows)))
for fn,s in rows[:20]: print(fn+' | '+s[:500])
PY
